label: Wolfram Language entity code
wrong_values: description 'Wolfram|Alpha brings expert-level knowledge and capabilities to the broadest possible range of people...' (site og:description tagline)
missing: Nothing to miss: the page is Wolfram|Alpha's 'Try the following / input not understood' help text. No name, dates or description of him.
label_issues: status 'ok', resolved true, entity_on_page true and has_data true are wrong. The page-text pass itself says about_entity false, page_kind 'error page'. Should be status wrong_page (query not understood), no entity data, access none, format_family none. 'embedded markup (rdfa)' rests only on generic og tags. The only entity-specific value is the echoed input string.
notable: The Wikidata formatter sends the Wolfram Language Entity[...] expression to the Wolfram|Alpha web input, which does not resolve it. The value may be valid inside the Wolfram Language, but the linked URL never shows a record. This is a formatter-URL problem, not a wrong id.

label: TMDB person ID
missing: Nothing substantial. Works are capped at 40 of about 119 credits, as designed. The archival acting credit (as Himself, 1909) appears only through occupation 'Actor'.
label_issues: None material. 'occupation' (n=18) is filled with TMDB credit job titles such as 'Novel', 'Short Story' and 'Story'. These are credit roles for source material, not occupations, so the element name overstates them.

label: Brockhaus Enzyklopädie online ID
wrong_values: image 'IMAGO/GRANGER HISTORICAL PICTURE ARCHIVE' (a photo credit string, not an image)
missing: Nothing beyond the paywalled article body. Only the free teaser is visible.
label_issues: None. 'wrong_page, ok' correctly reflects the two values: 'mark-twain' is an internal-error page and 'twain-mark' is the teaser article.
notable: Wikidata value 'mark-twain' is dead ('An internal error has occurred. The page may have been removed'). Only 'twain-mark' works, so the dead value could be removed from Wikidata. The article body is behind a subscription. Page text is an English machine translation.

label: National Library of Korea ID
wrong_values: description 'The definition of the subject resource.'
description 'A class representing a compound literal.'
missing: Work titles: nlon:create lists about 1346 opaque CNTS/KJU URIs with no titles. That is a site limitation, noted correctly. Nothing else substantial.
label_issues: Vocabulary triples from the RDF/RDFS/JSON-LD schema were parsed as if they were about him. That inflates values (84) and descriptive values, and probably uniqueness_bucket 'mostly unique (71%)', because strings like 'CompoundLiteral' are unique to this site. The bucket should be recomputed without them.
notable: Occupation '발명가' (inventor) is defensible because he held patents. The reviewers flagged a Wikidata gap there. birthPlace '미국 (플로리다)' (USA (Florida)) reads like the US state rather than Florida, Missouri, which is a site-side ambiguity.

notable: The record has no name label, only a definition. Dates come from the gloss '(1835-1910)'.
